meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE whenever a task needs a commit or git-history investigation. Covers atomic commits, staging, commit-message style, rebase, squash, fixup/autosquash, blame, bisect, reflog, git log -S/-G, and questions like who wrote this or when was this added. Do not use for ordinary code edits unless the user asks for git work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 Git 提交与历史，自动生成规范提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要规范提交或排查 Git 历史
copy.tagline_en: Manage Git commits and history with automated commit messages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to make clean commits or investigate Git history

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 遇到 Git 任务会先查仓库状态,把改动按逻辑拆成原子提交并逐一提交;也能整理提交历史,或查明谁在哪个提交改了什么,并给出证据。
howto.when: 当任务涉及提交改动或调查 Git 历史时触发,例如“谁改过这段代码”“这行何时加的”;普通代码编辑不会触发,除非用户明确要求 Git 操作。

say.text: 把当前改动按逻辑分成几个原子提交,并写规范的提交信息。
say.note: Claude 会先检查状态和最近提交风格,再分步提交。

say.text: 把最近这几个提交用 fixup 压缩成一个,再 rebase 整理历史。
say.note: 会先确认分支状态,再执行 autosquash 重写。

say.text: 查一下这行代码是谁、在哪个提交里加的。
say.note: 会用 blame 和 log 找出提交哈希作为证据。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude first checks the repo state, splits changes into logical atomic commits, and commits them one by one. It can also rewrite or tidy commit history, or investigate who changed what and in which commit, citing command evidence.
howto.when_en: Triggers whenever a task involves committing changes or investigating Git history—for example, “who changed this line” or “when was it added.” Ordinary code edits do not trigger it unless the user explicitly asks for Git work.

say_en.text: Split the current changes into logical atomic commits with proper messages.
say_en.note: It checks status and recent commit style first, then commits in steps.

say_en.text: Squash these recent commits into one with fixup, then rebase.
say_en.note: It verifies branch state before rewriting and uses autosquash.

say_en.text: Find who added this line and in which commit.
say_en.note: It uses blame and log to report the commit hash as evidence.
